body.statement: The recovered relation satisfies \(\mathcal C(\mathcal R)=\overline G\) up to the common latent permutation on \(\mathcal M^{\circ}_{\mathrm{term},p,q}(G,G)\cap\mathcal M^{\circ}_{\mathrm{branch},p,q}(G,G)\). The maps \(\mathcal R\mapsto\mathcal G_{\mathrm{soft}}(\mathcal R)\) and \((\mathcal R,\{\Sigma^{(k)}\}_{k\in K})\mapsto\mathcal G_{\mathrm{cov}}(\mathcal R,\{\Sigma^{(k)}\}_{k\in K})\) are invariant to the choice of representative of \(\mathcal R\) under \(\mathfrak M_q\). The rational projective gauge fixes every nonzero diagonal scale, and enumeration over the common permutation orbit leaves terminal ranks, exact-support inequations, covariance branches, realization covers, and separators invariant. If the inputs arise from \(\theta\in\mathcal M^{\circ}_{\mathrm{term},p,q}(G,G)\cap\mathcal M^{\circ}_{\mathrm{branch},p,q}(G,G)\cap\mathcal M^{\circ}_{s,p,q}(G,G')\) for the relevant covariance theorem label \(s\), then \(\mathcal G_{\mathrm{soft}}(\mathcal R)=\{\Pi_M(G'):G'\in\mathsf H_{\mathrm{soft}}(G),\ M\in\mathfrak M_q\}\) and \(\mathcal G_{\mathrm{cov}}(\mathcal R,\{\Sigma^{(k)}\}_{k\in K})=\{\Pi_M(G'):G'\in\mathsf{Cov}_{p}(G),\ M\in\mathfrak M_q\}\), where \(\Pi_M\) is the permutation part of \(M\). Hence the target is a functional of the explicit aligned factor input and covariance tuple, not a functional indexed by an unobserved true graph. This generic observable statement makes no pointwise assertion when a true variance change vanishes.
body.justification: This proposition makes the population target invariant to the unavoidable latent permutation and scaling ambiguity.
body.gap: The comparator results recover latent factors or graph classes only up to relabeling; they do not state this corrected covariance-versus-actual-row pair as one quotient-valued data functional.
body.consumer: This supplies the companion LCD workflow with a quotient-valued graph-class target for the Problem 5.1 correction and the robust covariance refinement motivated by Problem 5.2.
